antlers.definition: The branched horns of a deer.

sorcerer.definition: A person believed to have magical powers.

tusks.definition: Long pointed teeth that grow outside an animal’s mouth.

fangs.definition: Long sharp teeth used for biting.

goggles.definition: Special glasses that protect your eyes.

tracks.definition: Marks left by a moving person or animal.

herd.definition: A group of animals that live or move together.

flute.definition: A musical instrument played by blowing air into it.

bones.definition: The hard parts that form a body’s skeleton.

pit.definition: A deep hole in the ground.

robe.definition: A long loose piece of clothing.

reindeer.definition: A deer with large antlers that lives in cold places.

change out of.definition: To take off clothes and put on different ones.

patches.definition: Small areas different from the surrounding area.

window sill.definition: The ledge at the bottom of a window.

carved.definition: Cut into a surface to make a shape.

moonstone.definition: A stone with a soft shining appearance.

journeys.definition: Trips from one place to another.

stacks.definition: Groups of things placed one on another.

plain.definition: A large flat area of land.

freeze.definition: To become extremely cold or turn to ice.

hunted.definition: Searched for animals to catch for food.

traps.definition: Devices or holes used to catch animals.

peeked.definition: Looked out quickly from a hidden place.

shadowy.definition: Dark because there is little light.

entrance.definition: A place where you go in.

ancestors.definition: Family members who lived long ago.

borrow.definition: To use something and return it later.

coats.definition: Outer clothes that keep the body warm.

branches.definition: Parts of a tree growing from its trunk.

trapping.definition: Catching an animal in a trap.

slipped.definition: Lost a firm footing or grip.

mask.definition: A covering worn over the face.

bone.definition: A hard part inside an animal body.

gift.definition: Something given freely to another person.

parade.definition: A line of people or animals moving together.

slinking.definition: Moving quietly to avoid being noticed.

sunset.definition: The time when the sun goes below the horizon.

climbing.definition: Moving upward using hands and feet.

lesson.definition: A period of learning a skill.

corner.definition: A place where two sides meet.

grab.definition: To take hold of something quickly.

pointed.definition: Showed a direction with a finger.

shivering.definition: Shaking because of cold or fear.

shadows.definition: Dark shapes where light is blocked.

complete.definition: Finished with nothing left to do.

shoulder.definition: The body part between the neck and arm.

shouted.definition: Spoke in a very loud voice.

gently.definition: In a soft and careful way.

horizon.definition: The line where earth seems to meet sky.

distance.definition: A place far from where you are.

pocket.definition: A small bag sewn into clothes or a backpack.

neck.definition: The part joining the head to the body.
